PRUNEFS.default: NFS nfs nfs4 afs binfmt_misc proc smbfs autofs iso9660 ncpfs coda devpts ftpfs devfs mfs shfs sysfs cifs lustre_lite tmpfs usbfs udf ocfs2
PRUNEFS.description: Space-separated list of filesystem types to prune from the updatedb database.

PRUNEPATHS.description: Space-separated list of paths to prune from the updatedb database.

LOCALUSER.description: User under which the find command is run.

NICE.description: Nice value priority for the cron job (higher number = lower priority).

IONICE_CLASS.description: I/O scheduling class: 1 for real time, 2 for best-effort, 3 for idle.

IONICE_PRIORITY.description: I/O scheduling priority (0-7, only valid for classes 1 and 2).
